detail: Playwright (cli-c-inbox.e2e.ts): typed first..fourth in the Note textbox of /map/auth-login; `werk inbox` printed them in order as `[3] #auth-login ...` to `[6]`; `--since 3` gave second, third, fourth; `--since 3 -n 2` gave second, third.

Chat log .werk/chats/logs.jsonl = tool_result, person, agent ('we keep one log per conversation and never rewrite it'); `werk quote store logs "one log per conversation"` succeeded with one new excerpt.quoted event, held supported_by link from the ghost card, speaker agent, said at, session and span 8..32 all correct. But the excerpt shows `message: 2` (positions count from zero), not 3 as the step requires.

`quote card c "ship the reader first"` exit 1 'the text occurs in 2 messages (0, 1)'; `retry` exit 1 'the text occurs 2 times in message 2'; 'a sentence nobody said' exit 1 'no exact match ...'. The log is byte-identical, card:ex0 does not exist and the card shows no supported_by link.
'exit code 137' only in tool_call, tool_result and tooling lines; `werk quote` exit 1 'no exact match of the text in a spoken message of conversation c'; log length is the same and no excerpt exists.

`add card:ex1 --kind excerpt` refused ('An excerpt comes only from a quote'); `retitle card:ex0` and `edit card:ex0 --body` refused ('an excerpt's words never change'), log unchanged, words kept; `say card:ex0` saved a note shown on the excerpt; after `accept card --actor you`, edit and retitle are still refused and the words are kept.

Two ghost cards each with a quoted excerpt; `discard one` made `show one` and `show one:ex0` exit 1; `accept two --actor you` removed 'proposed' from both card and excerpt, and the excerpt still shows its words, speaker, said at, session, message 1 and span 0..12.

Root #base with two decided children, spec with stories 1-2, two tickets in the fixed format (second cites #card-b, blocked by 1, empty Checks). `werk ticket-check tickets --root base --spec spec.md` printed only '2 tickets, 0 own-check failures, 0 failures, ...' and exited 0.

Replaced line 9 (in What to build) of ticket 1 with a line naming src/loop.ts and Makefile, padded ticket 2 to 4248 chars. Output had '01-first.md: no-file-paths: What to build: line 9: src/loop.ts', '02-second.md: size: file: 4248 characters; the limit is 4000', no Makefile line, count line '4 failures', exit 1. (Set lines also appear because failing tickets do not count for the set.)

Three tickets, none cites card-b or the ghost, none lists story 3, 2<->3 blocked. Output: one 'ticket set: cards-cited ... #card-b', one 'ticket set: stories ... story 3', '02-two.md: blocked_by: ... cycle: 02-two.md, 03-three.md', no line names card-ghost, exit 1.

One ticket without a title line. Output: only '01-untitled.md: title: title: the file has no line "title: <text>"' for that file, plus 'ticket set: cards-cited ... #card-a' and 'ticket set: stories ... story 1'; exit 1.
Missing spec: exit 2, stderr 'no spec file "none.md"'; spec without User stories heading: exit 2; unknown root 'nope': exit 2; no --root: exit 2.

Chat log .werk/chats/s67.jsonl (werk reads conversations there, not from ~/.claude) with the user message at index 2; `quote #werk-excerpt s67 "written from memory"` exit 0; `show werk-excerpt:ex0` shows proposed, session s67, message 2, speaker user, span 36..55; the card shows '-> supported_by werk-excerpt:ex0'.

Quoted 'the tool never guesses' from an assistant message; read session, message, span and speaker from `show werk-excerpt:ex0`, then sliced line [message] of the chat log at [start,end): text matched exactly and speaker was assistant in both. 'Opens the excerpt' read as `werk show` of the excerpt.
`quote werk-excerpt s673 "the tool never gueses"` exit 1 'no exact match of the text in a spoken message of conversation s673'; event count unchanged; no werk-excerpt:ex0.
Text in messages 3 and 7; `werk quote` exit 1 'the text occurs in 2 messages (3, 7); quote more of the sentence'; no new event, no excerpt.
Decided card with a quoted ghost excerpt; `accept card:ex0 --actor you` exit 0; excerpt header lost 'proposed'; card shows '-> supported_by card:ex0 keep it simple' with no ghost/held tag.
`say #werk-chat "The reply streams over SSE"` exit 0, one new note.added event with payload.id werk-chat; `show #werk-chat` shows 'Thread / [3] agent: The reply streams over SSE'.

After `say` of first, second, third on #werk-chat, `werk inbox` printed nothing: the inbox lists only notes with actor 'you' (the person's), so the agent's own notes never show. Missing feature, not a binder error.
Agent notes on #werk-chat and #visual; `werk inbox` printed empty output (only person notes are listed, and it lists in log order, not grouped by card).
Ghost #werk-pane (added via `add`, linked from #visual with depends_on); `say #werk-pane "Describe the pane here"` exit 0, but `werk inbox` printed nothing because agent notes are not listed.
`say #no-such-card "lost note"` exit 1, stderr 'werk say: refused: unknown node #no-such-card'; log byte-identical; `werk inbox` does not show 'lost note'.
